quote: Except for a motor vehicle, no person shall park any vehicle on any street for a period of time longer than thirty minutes between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day.

activation.condition: A responsible person places a qualifying vehicle on a City street during the local 01:00–06:00 interval; original source review remains required.

obligation.description: Retain actual nonmotor vehicle parking duration against the strict thirty-minute boundary for independent review.

exceptions.description: Source-proven motor vehicle exception; a horse-drawn actor label does not establish classification.

timing.description: Measure original civil-time parking episode and overlap with 01:00–06:00; retain exact endpoint interpretation for independent review.

parameter_refs.name: civil_start_local
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed local date/time across 01:00 and 06:00 endpoints

parameter_refs.name: self_propelled_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed nonmotor versus motor vehicle construction

parameter_refs.name: activity_kind
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: actual parking or actual loading activity, independently observed
